mapper.select: SELECT version, description, success, execution_time AS "executionTime", TO_CHAR(installed_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "installedOn" FROM flyway_schema_history ORDER BY installed_rank DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT code_id AS "codeId", p_code_id AS "pCodeId", name, sort_no AS "sortNo", use_yn AS "useYn" FROM code ORDER BY p_code_id, sort_no, code_id

SELECT menu_id AS "menuId", p_menu_id AS "pMenuId", area, name, sort_no AS "sortNo", conn_cd AS "connCd", conn_id AS "connId", link_url AS "linkUrl", target_yn AS "targetYn", icon, use_yn AS "useYn" FROM menu ORDER BY area, p_menu_id, sort_no

SELECT config_key AS "configKey", value, input_type AS "inputType", name, description, group_cd AS "groupCd", sort_no AS "sortNo", public_yn AS "publicYn", use_yn AS "useYn" FROM config_item ORDER BY group_cd, sort_no, config_key
